title: The Norm-Five Spectral Gap
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · six norm-5 generators around a point, the Satake pair moving on and off the unit circle, a ledger of the six products at q = (2, 1, 3, −1), a bar chart of the six shell values, the degree-four integer matrix, and the radius-three ball of the Cayley graph X⁵ʼ¹³ with one 8-cycle
summary: Six integer quaternions of norm 5, 1 ± 2i, 1 ± 2j, 1 ± 2k, act on the three-sphere; their spherical Hecke sum is tested by the squared Ramanujan inequality 20 − λ̂² ≥ 0, which the constant fails (20 − 36 = −16). The Satake pair of 1 − λ̂X + 5X² moves on and off the unit circle as λ̂ crosses 2√5, while the 2 × 2 Toeplitz determinant (20 − λ̂²)/5 changes sign (hand derivation, argued); Lean checks the general finite Toeplitz criterion: PSD exactly when every parameter lies on the unit circle. A boundary card separates what is frozen, the Lubotzky–Phillips–Sarnak bound (literature) and the critical-line reading (the book's model) from open problems such as higher-rank Ramanujan–Petersson and ERH. At q = (2, 1, 3, −1) the six scalar parts 0, 4, −4, 8, 4, 0 give 112 and T̂₅χ₁(q) = −2/75 = −2/5 · χ₁(q) (computed); Lean checks the identity for every nonzero integer quaternion and the margin 496/25 > 0. Lean checks the recurrence a(n+2) = −6a(n+1) − 25a(n) and the six values −1/5, …, 16901/15625; reading them as traces on the shells V₁ to V₆ is the chapter's representation-theory argument. Lean checks the summed Gaussian-integer matrices 6I₂, −2I₃, −18I₄ and the degree-four matrix with corners 64, its eigenvalues +54 (twice) and −74 (three times), and the five margins; the shells V₃ to V₆ rest on the chapter's exact minor checks. Finally S₅ mod 13 gives the 2184-vertex bipartite Cayley graph X⁵ʼ¹³: its tree-like radius-3 ball and an 8-cycle are computed on screen, with the girth-8 witness (287, 416, 364, 52); the bound σ² < 19 comes from the chapter's exact shift certificate.
summary_zh: 六枚模方为 5 的整四元数 1 ± 2i、1 ± 2j、1 ± 2k 作用在三维球面上；它们的球面赫克和由平方后的拉马努金不等式 20 − λ̂² ≥ 0 检验，常值函数不满足（20 − 36 = −16）。λ̂ 越过 2√5 时，1 − λ̂X + 5X² 的佐武参数对离开单位圆，2 × 2 托普利茨行列式 (20 − λ̂²)/5 随之变号（手工推导，属论证）；Lean 检验一般的有限托普利茨判据：半正定当且仅当所有参数都在单位圆上。边界一幕把已冻结的结论、Lubotzky—Phillips—Sarnak 全谱界（文献结果）与临界线解读（本书的模型诠释），同高秩拉马努金—彼得松猜想、扩展黎曼猜想等开放问题分开。在 q = (2, 1, 3, −1)，六个标量部分 0、4、−4、8、4、0 的平方和为 112，T̂₅χ₁(q) = −2/75 = −2/5 · χ₁(q)（屏幕计算）；Lean 对一切非零整四元数检验该恒等式，并检验裕度 496/25 > 0。Lean 检验整数递推 a(n+2) = −6a(n+1) − 25a(n) 与前六个值 −1/5、…、16901/15625；把它们认作壳层 V₁ 至 V₆ 上的迹，是本章的表示论推导。Lean 检验六枚高斯整矩阵之和 6I₂、−2I₃、−18I₄ 与首尾以 64 耦合的四次矩阵、其本征值二重 +54 与三重 −74，以及五个裕度；V₃ 至 V₆ 依据本章的精确主子式核验。最后，S₅ 模 13 给出 2184 顶的双分凯莱图 X⁵ʼ¹³：半径 3 的树状邻域与一条 8 圈在屏幕上算出，围长 8 的见证为 (287, 416, 364, 52)；σ² < 19 来自本章的精确移位证书。
